items.sentence: Were I a student having hardships because of the current situation, education ___ not be important until the personal situation got resolved.
items.explanation: Were I a student ...는 if가 생략된 가정법 과거 조건절입니다. 주절에는 조동사의 과거형 would가 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: Were I a student having hardships because of the current situation, education would not be important until the personal situation got resolved.
items.prompt: 문장 앞의 도치된 조건절을 if를 포함한 절로 바꿔 입력하세요.
items.answer: if I were a student having hardships because of the current situation
items.explanation: 가정법에서 if가 생략되면 were가 주어 앞으로 이동할 수 있습니다. Were I ...를 If I were ...로 복원합니다.

items.sentence: In my own travels, had I taken packaged tours, I would never have had the eye-opening experiences that have added so much to my appreciation of human diversity.
items.prompt: had I taken packaged tours를 if절로 바꿔 입력하세요.
items.answer: if I had taken packaged tours
items.explanation: 가정법 과거완료에서 if가 생략되면 had가 주어 앞으로 도치됩니다. had I taken ...는 if I had taken ...로 복원합니다.
items.memory: Had + S + p.p. = If + S + had + p.p.

items.sentence: ___ everyone in our country worked just one year more beyond their expected age of retirement, we could have compensated for much of the shortfall in the national finances.
items.prompt: if가 생략된 가정법 과거완료 문장을 완성할 말을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하는 문맥이며 if가 생략되어 Had everyone ...의 도치 구조가 필요합니다.

items.sentence: Should you get an urgent request during the day, schedule it accordingly by reshuffling your already scheduled tasks and making the urgent task a priority.
items.prompt: Should you get an urgent request during the day를 if절로 바꿔 입력하세요.
items.answer: if you should get an urgent request during the day
items.explanation: Should + S + V는 if가 생략된 조건절 도치입니다. If + S + should + V로 복원할 수 있습니다.
items.memory: Should + S + V = If + S + should + V

items.sentence: Should you get an urgent request during the day, schedule it accordingly by reshuffling your already scheduled tasks and making the urgent task a priority.
items.explanation: schedule it accordingly는 ‘그 긴급한 요청을 상황에 맞게 일정에 반영하라’는 뜻이므로 it은 an urgent request를 가리킵니다.
